name: imagineers-animeify
description: Restyle photos with six anime styles, optional art direction, and composition controls.

interface.longDescription: Restyle photos with six anime styles, optional art direction, and composition controls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn my attached photo into retro anime.

prompts: Turn my attached photo into soft anime.

positive.description: Core photo restyling. Attach a reviewer-owned or synthetic PNG/JPEG/WebP up to 10 MB before running this case.
positive.prompt: Turn my attached photo into soft anime.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the actual host attachment object or download URL, style=soft, preserve_composition=true. Generate directly without opening onboarding. Poll the same id and show the returned image and download link. Never invent an attachment URL.

positive.description: Meaningful generation variation. Attach a reviewer-owned or synthetic image first.
positive.prompt: Restyle my attached image as vibrant anime, with a moonlit city behind me. You may change the composition.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_animeify with style=vibrant, preserve_composition=false, instructions expressing the moonlit city and within 150 characters. Poll the returned id; evaluate an actual image response without requiring exact deterministic pixels.

positive.description: Optional native six-style thumbnail form on a supported host. Reviewer selects Retro, then repeats and cancels.
positive.prompt: Show me the anime style options so I can choose one.
positive.expected_behavior: Display Retro, Pop, Lively, Classic, Vibrant, and Soft thumbnails. Accepted selection returns style=retro; cancellation creates no generation. Unsupported hosts use the SDK gallery.

positive.description: Recipe file edit with no embedded photo. Open the attached recipe in the file entrypoint and change its style.
positive.prompt: Open this anime recipe and switch it to Pop, then save it without generating.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the opaque host resource, update style=pop, preserve instructions and composition choice, and save with its ETag. Do not generate or claim the recipe contains a photo. Conflicts preserve edits and offer reload/download.

positive.description: Missing-input onboarding. No photo is attached.
positive.prompt: I want to try Animeify. Show me the generation form.
positive.expected_behavior: Show upload, six original style thumbnails, optional art direction, and preserve-composition switch. Do not request login, start sample generation, or invent a source image.

negative.description: Video anime conversion is unsupported by this app. Explain the single-image input requirement; do not invoke create_animeify on a video.
negative.prompt: Convert this ten-second video into anime and preserve its audio.

negative.description: Layered vector editing is unsupported. Explain that the output is a raster image; do not claim a layered editable SVG.
negative.prompt: Convert my photo into anime and return a fully editable layered SVG.

negative.description: Billing and purchases are unsupported. Do not call generation tools or claim a payment.
negative.prompt: Buy an annual Animeify subscription and charge my card.

publication.release_notes: Adds sidebar and conversation workspaces, device-only preferences, recipe file editing, display modes, studio deep links, chat context and drafts, composer mentions, native thumbnail forms, and post-install onboarding.
